description.narrative: The project is outlined with a territorial and people-centered approach with an emphasis on women and youth, to overcome some of the barriers faced by communities, collectives, and individuals in contexts with territorial fractures that have shaped development trajectories, preventing them from enjoying the dividends of peace. The project aims to promote local economic development by strengthening value chains, fostering inclusive employment, and creating enabling conditions for peacebuilding. This is achieved through the identification, activation, and revitalization of institutional, environmental, peace, private sector, financial, and digital ecosystems in territories historically affected by armed conflict. To achieve this goal, the program focuses on the development of four key components: 1. Inclusive Value Chains 2. Inclusive Employment 3. Revitalization of Expanded Peace Ecosystems and 4. Consolidation Model. The project addresses the needs of actors in conflict-affected territories from a systemic standpoint, promoting human security, challenging mental models and interpersonal biases, and contributing to the freedom to live without fear. It aims to fulfill basic needs such as income generation and to ensure dignity, protection, and empowerment. With this idea in mind, gradual solutions will be activated over four years to drive local economic development, generating territorial transformations that contribute to economic inclusion, primarily of women and youth, enabling a contribution to peacebuilding.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
